tweets.html: The Astros lost 4-3. They are 65-65.Houston has guaranteed itself a losing homestand against the Mariners, Angels and A's. The bullpen had its first hiccup in a while. The offense produced six hits. Peña, Paredes and Alvarez were a combined 1-for-11.
